about.text: The cow-milk version of raviggiolo, a soft fresh cheese from the Tosco-Romagnolo Apennines. Rennet is added and the milk left to coagulate briefly, then the curd is drained unbroken on mats or in baskets, often between fern, fig or cabbage leaves.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
